components.institution_label: Family and Medical Leave Act/California Family Rights Act (FMLA/CFRA)
components.description: Federal FMLA leave as restated in Staff PM 26: up to 12 weeks of job-protected unpaid leave in a rolling 12-month period, for bonding with a new child, the employee's own serious health condition (including pregnancy incapacity) or care of a seriously ill family member.
components.faculty_group_note: PM 26 is a Staff Personnel Memorandum ('S TAFF P ERSONNEL M EMORANDA'), listed on the HR page under 'Institute Staff Personnel Policies (Personnel Memoranda)'; its text says it 'applies to Institute employees working in California', speaks of 'A staff employee's position' and of exceptions 'for campus staff'. The Faculty Handbook (index page) has its own Chapter 5 sections 'Sick Leave' and 'Disability; Child-bearing Leave; Child-Care Leave', not saved.
components.eligible_parent_wording: For the birth of a child or care for a newborn, or for the placement or care of a child who is newly placed with the employee for adoption or foster care; own serious health condition; care for a spouse, registered domestic partner
components.service_requirement: employed by the Institute for at least one year and at least 1250 hours over the previous 12 months
components.entitlement_note: Statutory entitlement; the memo says the Institute 'will provide' it.
components.duration_note: Up to 12 weeks in a rolling 12-month period (26 weeks for military caregiver leave, not a parental purpose). Statute: 12 workweeks.
components.dual_employee_rule: If both parents are Institute employees, a maximum of 12 weeks combined Bonding Leave
components.time_window: Bonding Leave must be requested and concluded within 12 months of the birth, adoption or foster placement
components.notice: An employee should provide his/her supervisor a schedule in advance of his/her time off (bonding)
components.relief_note: Formal leave of absence; relief not stated (R9).

sequence.note: PM 26 4.4: the first 12 weeks of PDL run concurrently with FMLA (S1). Applies to the birth parent only; for the non-birth parent FMLA starts at the bonding leave.

notes: 2018_01 is an index page: the Faculty Handbook table of contents. It holds no policy text. It shows that the governing faculty document (2016 Faculty Handbook, Chapter 5: 'Sick Leave'; 'Disability; Child-bearing Leave; Child-Care Leave'; 'Scholarly Leave of Absence') exists but is not saved (on-campus access only, per the page). cross_reference_not_saved: Faculty Handbook 2016, Chapter 5.

2018_03 is an index page (HR policies list). It lists PM 25 Personal Leaves of Absence, PM 26, PM 27 Other Leaves of Absence, PM 15-2 Paid Time Off for Benefit Based Employees, and the Institute policy 'Disability and Reasonable Accommodation' (for faculty, staff and students); none of these except PM 26 is saved.

2018_02 (Staff PM 26, dated March 6, 2014, linked from the HR page captured 2018-02-18) is the only policy text. It is a Staff Personnel Memorandum; every component is coded with faculty_group naming staff and flagged ambiguous on coverage. The condition of the rule for records with no governing document (reader instructions §3) is not met because PM 26 states parental and childbirth provisions (bonding leave, pregnancy disability leave), so missing is false; but no saved source sets leave for main-campus tenure-stream faculty, and no component counts in the figures except via the FMLA statutory floor (U7).

Cross-references not saved: Faculty Handbook 2016 Chapter 5; Employee Benefits Handbook; PM 14 Terminations; PM 15-2 Paid Time Off for Benefit Based Employees; PM 25 Personal Leaves of Absence; PM 27 Other Leaves of Absence; Institute policy 'Disability and Reasonable Accommodation'.

Birth parent chain (staff): Pregnancy Disability Leave up to 4 months (FMLA 12 weeks concurrent from its start; own sick leave within; SDI from week 2) -> CFRA bonding leave 12 weeks (own vacation within; CA PFL concurrent). Disability leave c4 concurrent with FMLA/CFRA; all leaves capped at 24 months.
Non-birth parent chain (staff): FMLA and CFRA bonding leave 12 weeks together (own vacation within CFRA; CA PFL concurrent with CFRA).
Calendar: no term length or kind of term is stated in the saved sources; calendar omitted.
CFRA and PDL were checked against the saved statute texts (2026_02, 2026_03), which are the current versions; the lengths used (12 workweeks; up to four months) are those PM 26 states for 2014-2018.
